# OpusCraft — The Executive Publishing Studio

> OpusCraft is an authority authoring platform for founders, consultants, and operators to synthesize notes, voice transcripts, and frameworks into Amazon KDP-grade books with zero context drift.

## Primary Documentation & Features
- [Product Architecture](https://opuscraft.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed overview of source ingestion, global context memory, and 2-layer vector cover engines.
- [Voice-to-Book Workflow](https://opuscraft.com/blog/voice-to-book-framework-for-experts): The 4-step framework for turning audio memos into non-fiction chapters.
- [Why Raw ChatGPT Fails](https://opuscraft.com/blog/why-chatgpt-fails-at-writing-books): Technical breakdown of context amnesia, semantic drift, and KDP formatting standards.
- [Tool Comparison](https://opuscraft.com/blog/best-ai-ebook-generators-compared): Technical feature matrix comparing OpusCraft against GetEbook.ai and Designrr.
- [Pricing & Credit Rules](https://opuscraft.com#pricing): Breakdown of Starter (free credits), Creator ($29/mo), and Agency ($79/mo) plans.

## Specifications
- Print Output: 6x9 inch trade paperback, 0.75" inside gutter margins, 0.5" outside margins, widow/orphan suppression (3-line limit).
- Digital Output: Reflowable IDPF-compliant EPUB.
- Voice Ingestion: OpenAI Whisper model accepting MP3, WAV, and M4A up to 25MB.
- Cover Engine: DALL-E 3 background art composited beneath vector SVG typography overlays.
